newsitem.title: PERU: Japan's Foreign Minister Ikeda arrives in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Foreign Minister Ikeda arrives in Peru.

text.p: Japan's Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda arrived in Lima on Thursday as negotiations continued with armed leftist rebels holding hundreds of people hostage at the Japanese ambassador's residence.

Airport officials said Ikeda arrived from Tokyo with a delegation of more than 100 people at around 6 p.m. EST (2300 GMT) and went directly to a hotel in the San Isidro district close to the compound.
Ikeda, who made no public statement at Lima airport, was reportedly due to give a news conference later on Thursday.
He intends to help the Peruvian government in negotiations with the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels who have threatened to kill some 400 hostages if their demands are not met.
